a.text: In 2015 she was awarded the Most Excellent Order of the British Empire.

b.text: Ayuso was appointed an Officer of The Order of the British Empire.

a.text: In 1983 she graduated with a technological architectural degree.
In 2008, after serving two years on the Senate, Ayuso was appointed chair of the National Womens Commission.

b.text: That same year she was also appointed to serve as Belize's delegate to the Inter-American Commission of Women.
